summary: TOOL-4 Filter products by category and brand
description:
As a customer, I want to filter so I can narrow down the catalogue.

* Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
* Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
* Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
* Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

criteria.text: Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

cases.title: Selecting one category shows only products from that category
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is available with <a category that has at least two products> and at least one product belonging to a different category. No filters are currently selected.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters selected.
Select the category filter <a category that has at least two products>.
cases.expected: Only products from the selected category appear in the list. Products belonging to other categories are no longer shown.

cases.title: Selecting two categories shows products from both categories
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is available with <a first category that has at least one product> and <a second, different category that has at least one product>, plus at least one product in a third category. No filters are currently selected.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters selected.
Select the category filter <a first category that has at least one product>.
Also select the category filter <a second, different category that has at least one product>.
cases.expected: Products from both selected categories appear in the list. Products belonging to neither selected category are not shown.

cases.title: Combining a category and a brand shows only products matching both
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is available with <a category and a brand that together have at least one matching product>, plus at least one product in that category from a different brand and at least one product of that brand in a different category. No filters are currently selected.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters selected.
Select the category filter <the category from the matching category/brand pair>.
Select the brand filter <the brand from the matching category/brand pair>.
cases.expected: Only products that match both the selected category and the selected brand appear. Products matching only the category, and products matching only the brand, are not shown.

cases.title: Unchecking all filters returns the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is available with products across more than one category and more than one brand. No filters are currently selected.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters selected and note the full list of products shown.
Select the category filter <any category that has at least one product> and confirm the list is narrowed.
Select the brand filter <any brand that has at least one product> and confirm the list is narrowed.
Uncheck the selected category filter so that no filters remain selected.
cases.expected: With all filters unchecked, the full product list returns and matches the list noted in step 1.
